name: Context Efficiency
description: Tactics for large repositories, noisy tool output, long sessions, and token pressure: search before reading, read ranges not files, keep logs and generated output out of context, never reread unchanged files or rerun unchanged passing checks, prefer deterministic scripts. Use when context volume materially affects execution quality; never reduces necessary reasoning, security, or verification.
verification_requirements: no required check skipped in the name of efficiency; skipped checks named
